description: This file contains Pydantic data models used for API request/response schemas related to site management, energy readings, alerts, benchmarking, and timeseries data within an energy insights platform.

classes.name: SiteCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new site, including customer name, site name, timezone, optional sqft and industry.

classes.name: SiteOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting site information, including ID and descriptive fields.

classes.name: IntervalReadingIn
classes.description: Schema representing a single interval energy reading submitted by a site.

classes.name: UploadReadingsRequest
classes.description: Wrapper schema for a list of interval readings to be uploaded.

classes.name: UploadReadingsResponse
classes.description: Schema indicating the number of readings inserted and duplicates skipped after upload.

classes.name: TimeseriesPoint
classes.description: Data point in a timeseries with timestamp, kWh, and optional demand.

classes.name: TimeseriesResponse
classes.description: Schema for a timeseries data response, including site ID, meter ID, interval range, and points.

classes.name: AlertOut
classes.description: Schema for alert information generated by the system.

classes.name: BenchmarkResponse
classes.description: Benchmarking data for a site within a specified time range, including total kWh and group statistics.
